researchResults.name: Abdomen Anatomy Jigsaw Puzzle
researchResults.description: A GIANTmicrobes-branded jigsaw puzzle depicting a cross-section of the human abdominal cavity, with pieces forming the stomach, small and large intestines, pancreas, liver, and gallbladder, held together by connective mesentery tissue. It was part of a 3-puzzle anatomy series alongside a Head and a Thorax jigsaw puzzle.
researchResults.source: archive.org snapshot of giantmicrobes.com/us/products/abdomen-jigsaw-puzzle.html (2020-05-12)

researchResults.name: Addiction Coasters
researchResults.description: A pack of 10 letterpress-printed drink coasters, packaged in a petri dish, each printed with the molecular structure of an addictive substance (sugar, alcohol, caffeine, tobacco, marijuana) -- tagline: "Addiction Coasters under a microscope!"
researchResults.source: archive.org snapshot of giantmicrobes.com/us/products/addiction-coaster.html (2018-11-04)

researchResults.name: GIANTmicrobes(R) Vinyl: Ahhh-lbert
researchResults.description: A vinyl figure (not the usual plush) representing Streptococcus pyogenes, the bacterium that causes strep/sore throat -- the name "Ahhh-lbert" is a pun on opening your mouth to say "ah" for a throat exam. It shipped with a flip book and sticker as part of GIANTmicrobes' original vinyl figure line (alongside Sniffles, Bellie, and Dr. Larkin).
researchResults.source: archive.org snapshot of giantmicrobes.com/us/products/ahhh-lbert.html (2010-11-14); cross-referenced with theblotsays.com blog post on the GIANTmicrobes Vinyl Figure Series

researchResults.name: GIANTmicrobes(R) Vinyl: Ahhh-lbert
researchResults.description: Same product as the "Ahhh-lbert" vinyl figure (Streptococcus pyogenes / strep throat) reached via an alternate product-page URL; this version's archived page shows the figure packaged with its box, and it also includes a flip book and sticker.
researchResults.source: archive.org snapshot of giantmicrobes.com/us/products/ahhh-lbert-vinyl.html (2010-11-12)

researchResults.name: Algae (Anabaena) Petri Dish
researchResults.description: A miniature GIANTmicrobes plush of Anabaena, a filamentous blue-green algae (cyanobacteria) that forms slimy colonies in ponds, lakes, and fish tanks, packaged inside a plastic petri dish as part of the "pool party" themed water-organism set.
researchResults.source: archive.org snapshot of giantmicrobes.com/us/products/algae-petri.html (2015-03-11)

researchResults.name: Allosaurus Skull Key Chain
researchResults.description: A miniature plush key chain shaped like the skull of Allosaurus, a large Jurassic-period predatory dinosaur (155-150 million years ago) known for its powerful arms, ripping claws, and hatchet-like jaws used to attack prey such as Stegosaurus and Diplodocus. Part of GIANTmicrobes' "Fuzzy Fossils" dinosaur-themed line.
researchResults.source: still live on giantmicrobes.com/us/products/allosaurus-skull-kc.html (confirmed via Wayback CDX index and direct image fetch)

researchResults.name: Amoeba Key Chain 12 Pack
researchResults.description: A bulk pack of 12 GIANTmicrobes Amoeba (Amoeba proteus, shown blue) mini plush microbes, each about 3 inches with a mini info tag and orange key chain clip.
researchResults.source: archive.org snapshot of giantmicrobes.com/us/products/amoeba-kc-pack.html (title/description, 2017) and giantmicrobes.com/es/products/amoeba-kc-pack.html (image, 2020)

researchResults.name: Paramecium & Amoeba Color Earrings
researchResults.description: A pair of earrings depicting Amoeba and Paramecium, two well-known freshwater protozoa; made from laminated, die-cut cereal-box paperboard as part of GIANTmicrobes' science/nature-inspired jewelry line.
researchResults.source: archive.org snapshot of giantmicrobes.com/us/products/amoeba-paramecium-earrings.html, captured 2018-11-04

researchResults.name: Amoeba (Amoeba proteus) Petri Dish
researchResults.description: A Petri-dish-packaged set of GIANTmicrobes mini plush Amoeba proteus figures in different mood colors (blue/orange/yellow); Amoeba proteus is a real freshwater amoeba known for constantly changing shape.
researchResults.source: archive.org snapshot of giantmicrobes.com/us/catalog/product/view/id/2029/s/amoeba-petri/category/3/, captured 2015-09-05

researchResults.name: GIANTmicrobes Primordial Putty: Amoeba
researchResults.description: A collectible mini Amoeba GIANTmicrobes figure packaged inside orange putty, sold with an educational label about the organism; part of the Primordial Putty line (alongside Anthrax, Black Death, Ebola, Chickenpox, Common Cold, Mad Cow, Flesh Eating).
researchResults.source: archive.org snapshot of giantmicrobes.com/us/products/amoeba-putty.html, captured 2015-09-05; corroborated by Giant Microbes Wiki (giantmicrobes.fandom.com/wiki/Primordial_Putty)

researchResults.name: Animal and Plant Cell Earrings
researchResults.description: A pair of earrings depicting a cross-section of an animal cell and a plant cell, made of laminated, die-cut recycled cereal-box paperboard; part of GIANTmicrobes' science/nature jewelry line.
researchResults.source: archive.org snapshot of giantmicrobes.com/us/products/animal-plant-cell-earrings.html, captured 2022-08-17

researchResults.name: Animal & Plant Cells Color Earrings

researchResults.name: Anopheles Mosquito
researchResults.description: A plush based on the Anopheles mosquito, the genus responsible for spreading malaria; among the roughly 3,000 mosquito species, Anopheles is considered the deadliest because it carries and transmits the malaria parasite.
researchResults.source: giantmicrobes.com UK product page (live, /uk/products/anopheles-mosquito.html)

researchResults.name: Anthrax (Bacillus anthracis) Petri Dish
researchResults.description: A GIANTmicrobes Petri Dish edition of Anthrax, representing the spore-forming bacterium Bacillus anthracis under a microscope; marketed with the tagline 'the mail-order mother of all biological weapons.'
researchResults.source: archive.org snapshot (2018-11-04) of https://www.giantmicrobes.com/us/products/anthrax-petri.html; image URL confirmed still live on giantmicrobes.com media path

researchResults.name: GIANTmicrobes(R) Primordial Putty: Anthrax
researchResults.description: Part of the GIANTmicrobes 'Primordial Putty' line: a collectible mini Anthrax (Bacillus anthracis) figure packaged inside orange putty, sold alongside other Primordial Putty characters like Black Death, Ebola, and Flesh Eating.
researchResults.source: archive.org snapshot (2015-12-05) of https://www.giantmicrobes.com/us/products/anthrax-putty.html; image served via archive.org im_ proxy (original mage.giantmicrobes.com host no longer resolves)

researchResults.name: Antibody Key Chain 12 Pack
researchResults.description: A bulk pack of 12 GIANTmicrobes Antibody (immunoglobulin) mini plush keychains (about 3 inches each), each with a detachable mini Antigen piece, mini-tag, and key chain clip; marketed to students, doctors, and health educators.
researchResults.source: archive.org snapshot (2026-02-19) of https://www.giantmicrobes.com/us/products/antibody-kc-pack.html; image URL confirmed still live on giantmicrobes.com media path

researchResults.name: Archaeopteryx Skull
researchResults.description: A fossil-themed plush of the skull of Archaeopteryx, an early Jurassic-period dinosaur (c. 145 million years ago) regarded by many as the first bird, discovered in Germany in 1859; its name means 'ancient wing' and it is considered a key transitional fossil linking dinosaurs and birds.
researchResults.source: giantmicrobes.com live product page at /us/products/archaeopteryx-skull.html (older slug without '-new'); confirmed same image set also used on archived /archaeopteryx-skull-new.html snapshot, indicating it's the same product under an alternate/newer URL

researchResults.name: Asthma Key Chain
researchResults.description: A mini plush (about 3.5 inches) representing asthma, a chronic respiratory disease causing airway inflammation; the product notes asthma affects over 200 million people globally and is the most common chronic disease among children.
researchResults.source: archive.org snapshot (2025-11-25) of https://www.giantmicrobes.com/us/products/asthma-kc.html; image URL confirmed still live on giantmicrobes.com media path

researchResults.name: Athlete's Foot
researchResults.description: A GIANTmicrobes plush representing Trichophyton mentagrophytes, the fungus that causes athlete's foot (tinea pedis). The standard-size plush (about 5-8 inches) is sold with an educational card describing the real organism, based on electron micrographs.
researchResults.source: Live product page giantmicrobes.com/us/products/athletesfoot.html (currently on site; image URL verified 200 image/jpeg)

researchResults.name: Athlete's Foot (Trichophyton mentagrophytes) Petri Dish
researchResults.description: A miniature GIANTmicrobes format: a small Athlete's Foot (Trichophyton mentagrophytes) plush packaged inside a plastic petri dish, shown 'under a microscope' on the product page. Represents the same fungus as the full-size Athlete's Foot plush.
researchResults.source: archive.org snapshot (2018-11-04) of https://www.giantmicrobes.com/us/products/athletesfoot-petri.html; also confirmed on Amazon (ASIN B06W9F42S7) and eBay listings

researchResults.name: Atom Earrings
researchResults.description: Silver-plated metal earrings shaped like a Bohr-model atom (a central nucleus with three orbiting electrons), each roughly one square inch, sold as a GIANTmicrobes science-jewelry item.
researchResults.source: archive.org snapshot (2019-10-14) of https://www.giantmicrobes.com/us/products/atom-earrings.html

researchResults.name: Atom Necklace
researchResults.description: A GIANTmicrobes necklace featuring a rhodium-plated, laser-cut atom pendant (Bohr model with three orbiting electrons, about one square inch) on a 16-inch sterling silver microball chain with a c-clasp.
researchResults.source: archive.org snapshot (2019-01-16) of https://www.giantmicrobes.com/us/products/atom-necklace.html

researchResults.name: Atom Silver & Pearl Earrings

researchResults.name: Atom Silver & Pearl Necklace

researchResults.name: Babesia (Babesia microti)
researchResults.description: Babesia is a fast-spreading tick-borne parasite (transmitted mainly by the deer tick, Ixodes scapularis) that causes malaria-like symptoms in humans by infecting red blood cells. GIANTmicrobes' plush version is marketed to outdoorsmen, hunters, and medical professionals as a lighthearted reminder to check for ticks.
researchResults.source: archive.org snapshot (2016-05-30) at https://web.archive.org/web/20160530104217/http://www.giantmicrobes.com/us/products/babesia.html, SKU GMUS-PD-0035

researchResults.name: Bone Cell (Osteocyte) Petri Dish
researchResults.description: A GIANTmicrobes petri-dish set containing 3 mini plush Bone Cell (Osteocyte) microbes, with educational facts about real bone cells (osteocytes regulate minerals in bone) printed inside the dish. Sold as a novelty/educational science gift; 10% of proceeds reportedly supported the Bone Health and Osteoporosis Foundation.
researchResults.source: Google-indexed official page title "Bone Cell (Osteocyte) Petri Dish" at giantmicrobes.com/uk/products/bonecell-petri.html (now 404, confirming discontinuation); corroborated by School Specialty and Walmart listings for the same item
researchResults.notes: Could not retrieve a working direct image URL; giantmicrobes.com, schoolspecialty.com, and walmart.com all blocked automated fetch attempts (403/CAPTCHA).

researchResults.name: Booger Key Chain (12 Pack)
researchResults.description: A bulk 12-pack of GIANTmicrobes' Booger key chain minis (dried nasal mucus themed plush, ~3.5in, each with a key chain clip and educational fact tag about mucus and immune function). The standalone single Booger Key Chain is a confirmed, well-documented GIANTmicrobes product; the 12-pack format matches the exact naming/format convention used for dozens of other confirmed GIANTmicrobes key-chain packs (e.g. antibody-kc-pack, ecoli-kc-pack, braincell-kc-pack, bed-bug-kc-pack).
researchResults.source: Pattern/naming inference from confirmed sibling 12-pack products on giantmicrobes.com plus the confirmed single Booger Key Chain listing on knickknacktoyshack.com (image is of the single-unit item, same design as sold in the pack)
researchResults.notes: Could not find a page/listing specifically confirming the pack variant by name (only the singular Booger Key Chain and other items' 12-packs were directly confirmed), so treat pack-specific existence as plausible but not fully verified. Image shown is of the single keychain unit, not a photo of the packaged 12-count set.

researchResults.name: Bookworm Key Chain 12 Pack
researchResults.description: A bulk pack of 12 GIANTmicrobes Bookworm mini plush key chains (~8cm each, with mini-tag and key ring clip). The Bookworm plush represents Anobium punctatum, the furniture/deathwatch beetle whose larvae are colloquially called "bookworms," marketed toward readers, teachers, and book lovers.
researchResults.source: Google-indexed official page title "Bookworm Key Chain 12 Pack - Nerdy Plush Set | GIANTmicrobes" at giantmicrobes.com/uk/products/bookworm-kc-pack.html (now 404, confirming discontinuation)
researchResults.notes: Could not retrieve a working direct image URL; giantmicrobes.com blocked automated fetch attempts (403).

researchResults.name: Bookworm Petri Dish (3 Mini Plush)

researchResults.source: European reseller Space & Cartoon Safari, product GM-PETRI-BOOKWORM (spacecartoonsafari.eu), corroborated by an eBay sold/listed item titled "GIANT MICROBES-BOOKWORM PETRI DISH-Stuffed Plush Furniture Beetle Insect Larva"

researchResults.name: Copepod (Centropages hamatus)
researchResults.description: A GIANTmicrobes plush modeled on Centropages hamatus, a real species of copepod (a small crustacean found in both marine and freshwater habitats), marketed as one of the most abundant multicellular creatures on Earth.
researchResults.source: Live giantmicrobes.com UK product page at https://www.giantmicrobes.com/uk/products/copepod.html

researchResults.name: Copepod Petri Dish
researchResults.description: A petri-dish gift set containing 3 miniature Copepod (Centropages hamatus) plush figures; per the archived product page, marketed as one of the most abundant multicellular creatures in the world, letting buyers 'take home 1 or 1,000 of them.'
researchResults.source: archive.org snapshot at http://web.archive.org/web/20150912105324/http://www.giantmicrobes.com/es/products/copepod-petri.html (Spanish-store listing, dated 2015-09-12); also referenced via US product pages in later Wayback captures

researchResults.name: Coronavirus Art Mug
researchResults.description: An 11-ounce ceramic mug featuring dozens of colorful illustrated GIANTmicrobes-style coronavirus (SARS-CoV-2) particles, sold dishwasher-safe in a colorful box as part of GIANTmicrobes' COVID-19 product line.
researchResults.source: archive.org snapshot at http://web.archive.org/web/20201203104827/https://www.giantmicrobes.com/us/products/coronavirus-art-mug.html (dated 2020-12-03)

researchResults.name: COVID-19 Dog Toy
researchResults.description: A 7x7x7-inch plush pet toy shaped like the SARS-CoV-2 coronavirus, with embroidered eyes, a squeaker, and durable pet-safe materials, marketed as letting dogs 'tug, chase and fetch' the virus.
researchResults.source: archive.org snapshot at http://web.archive.org/web/20210525183305/https://www.giantmicrobes.com/us/products/coronavirus-dog-toy.html (dated 2021-05-25); also confirmed for sale via Amazon and DirtyDogs.com listings

researchResults.name: Graduation 2021 - Class of COVID
researchResults.description: A special-edition COVID-19/SARS-CoV-2 plush commemorating graduating during the COVID-19 pandemic ('a year like no other in history'); includes an informational tag about the virus and coronaviruses' zoonotic origins.
researchResults.source: Live giantmicrobes.com UK product page at https://www.giantmicrobes.com/uk/products/coronavirus-graduation-2021.html; also sold on Amazon as 'GIANTmicrobes Graduation 2021 Class of COVID'

researchResults.name: Graduation 2021 Class of COVID
researchResults.description: A GIANTmicrobes plush of the COVID-19 coronavirus (SARS-CoV-2) in a special graduation-themed 2021 edition, sold as a keepsake commemorating graduating during the pandemic.
researchResults.source: giantmicrobes.com/uk product page (live), https://www.giantmicrobes.com/uk/products/coronavirus-graduation-2021.html

researchResults.name: Graduation 2021 Class of COVID Key Chain
researchResults.description: The keychain-sized version of GIANTmicrobes' 2021 graduation-edition COVID-19 (SARS-CoV-2) plush, meant as a small commemorative gift for 2021 graduates.
researchResults.source: giantmicrobes.com/uk product page (live), https://www.giantmicrobes.com/uk/products/coronavirus-graduation-2021-kc.html

researchResults.name: Graduation 2020 Class of COVID Key Chain
researchResults.description: The original (2020, not 2021) graduation-edition keychain plush of the COVID-19 coronavirus, released as a pandemic-era graduation keepsake and later superseded on the site by the 2021 edition.
researchResults.source: archive.org snapshot at http://web.archive.org/web/20200928024646/https://www.giantmicrobes.com/us/products/coronavirus-graduation-kc.html (page title: "Graduation 2020 Class of COVID Key Chain")

researchResults.name: Coronavirus Sisters 2-pack
researchResults.description: A two-plush set pairing the COVID-19 coronavirus (SARS-CoV-2) with SARS, marketed to highlight that SARS was an earlier, related coronavirus epidemic (2003) that preceded the COVID-19 pandemic.
researchResults.source: archive.org snapshot at http://web.archive.org/web/20201203103923/https://www.giantmicrobes.com/us/products/coronavirus-sisters.html (page title: "Coronavirus Sisters 2-pack")

researchResults.name: Coronavirus Sisters 3-pack
researchResults.description: A three-plush set of related coronaviruses -- COVID-19 (SARS-CoV-2), SARS, and MERS -- sold together as an educational set about the coronavirus family, since SARS and MERS were earlier coronavirus epidemics that predated COVID-19.
researchResults.source: giantmicrobes.com/uk product page (live), https://www.giantmicrobes.com/uk/products/coronavirus-sisters-pack.html

researchResults.name: Cough (Bordetella pertussis) Petri Dish
researchResults.description: A GIANTmicrobes plush of Bordetella pertussis, the bacterium that causes whooping cough, packaged in the company's petri-dish presentation format rather than as a standalone plush.
researchResults.source: archive.org snapshot at http://web.archive.org/web/20150225054901/http://www.giantmicrobes.com/us/products/cough-petri.html (page title: "Cough (Bordetella pertussis) Petri Dish"); corroborated by Skazzy blog post (skazzy506.wordpress.com) and the still-live UK listing page for the same item

researchResults.name: Charles Darwin Candle (Charles Darwin Secular Saint Candle)
researchResults.description: Not a GIANTmicrobes-brand plush, but a novelty devotional candle sold in the GIANTmicrobes.com gift shop: an 8-inch glass votive candle with Charles Darwin's image on the front and a mock 'patronage/saint's day/prayer' on the back, part of the 'Secular Saints' line made by The Unemployed Philosophers Guild.
researchResults.source: archive.org snapshot of https://www.giantmicrobes.com/us/products/darwin-candle.html (2017)

researchResults.name: Darwin Doll (Charles Darwin Little Thinker Doll)
researchResults.description: A 12-inch soft plush 'Little Thinker' collectible doll depicting Charles Darwin in a gray suit with a full beard and bald head, sold via the GIANTmicrobes.com gift shop; made by The Unemployed Philosophers Guild rather than GIANTmicrobes itself.
researchResults.source: archive.org snapshot of https://www.giantmicrobes.com/us/products/darwin-doll.html (2017)

researchResults.name: Darwin Pint Glass
researchResults.description: A pint glass printed with a Charles Darwin design using eco-friendly high-temperature-fired ceramic ink, sold in the GIANTmicrobes.com gift/novelty section (marketed as a beer-collecting/'life's mysteries' novelty item, not a GIANTmicrobes plush).
researchResults.source: archive.org snapshot of https://www.giantmicrobes.com/us/products/darwin-pint-glass.html (2018)

researchResults.name: Darwin Finger Puppet (Charles Darwin Magnetic Personality)
researchResults.description: A roughly 4-inch plush finger puppet of Charles Darwin that doubles as a refrigerator magnet, sold via the GIANTmicrobes.com gift shop; made by The Unemployed Philosophers Guild as part of their 'Magnetic Personality' line, not a GIANTmicrobes-brand microbe plush.
researchResults.source: archive.org snapshot of https://www.giantmicrobes.com/us/products/darwin-puppet.html (2017)

researchResults.name: Darwin Strong Crew Socks
researchResults.description: Charles Darwin/evolution-themed crew socks (fits men's shoe sizes 7-13), sold in the GIANTmicrobes.com gift shop as a novelty science-lover item rather than a GIANTmicrobes plush toy.
researchResults.source: archive.org snapshot of https://www.giantmicrobes.com/us/products/darwin-socks.html (2017)

researchResults.name: Diarrhea (Campylobacter jejuni) Petri Dish
researchResults.description: A genuine GIANTmicrobes plush product: a mini plush representation of Campylobacter jejuni bacteria (a common cause of infectious diarrhea) presented inside a plush 'petri dish', part of the now-discontinued GIANTmicrobes Petri Dish product line.
researchResults.source: archive.org snapshot of http://www.giantmicrobes.com/us/products/diarrhea-petri.html (2016)
